name: Medusan
origin: A city far to the west, in a land nobody here has even begun to think about.
backstory: One of five professors brought from around the world to reopen the University of Tyrnea, as it reopens alongside the town's revival led by Folkorlo's glass factory. Teaches algae and the deep seas.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only if Tyrnea's university becomes a place people actually come to learn, not just the town's revival slogan
criterion.wasted_life: one spent lecturing to empty halls at a university that never became more than an excuse for the town to say it has one
criterion.trusts: a published, peer-checked account over a traveler's impression
criterion.distrusts: a claim nobody bothered to write down and defend

routines.routine_actions: lectures on tidal life and algae to a small but growing class, argues taxonomy with the other visiting professors over the reopened library's half-empty shelves
unwinds at the tavern most evenings, still getting used to a town this quiet after wherever he came from
makes the long correspondence run back toward the western coast every so often, gone for stretches at a time, bringing back specimens and letters

arc.premise: Medusan wants to build the university's first real specimen archive of deep-sea and algae life - proof his field belongs here as more than a curiosity slot in the new curriculum. Resolution: the archive either gets a permanent room and the university's backing, or the department folds into someone else's for lack of interest and his specimens go into storage nobody visits.
